name: refusal-note-ink
breaks: RefusalNote draws cream on cream, the invisible-type defect that has shipped three times (#389) The sweep moved to BannerSweep in #1257: it was one test in BannerLegibilityTests holding 30.7s of the suite's test bodies, and a class can never finish faster than its longest test. Slice A rather than the whole sweep, because a mutation only has to be caught once and running all three would prove the same thing three times.
